sanity/schema.ts.name: Content schema index
sanity/schema.ts.description: Registers every content type (products, pages, settings) so the content system knows what data to expect.

sanity/schemas/page.ts.name: Page content shape
sanity/schemas/page.ts.description: Defines what fields an editorial page has in the content system, such as title and body text.

sanity/schemas/product.ts.name: Product content shape
sanity/schemas/product.ts.description: Defines the fields a product has in the content system — title, images, price, options, and stock status.

sanity/schemas/settings.ts.name: Site-wide settings shape
sanity/schemas/settings.ts.description: Defines the global settings stored in the content system, like site name and default metadata.

types/next-auth.d.ts.name: Sign-in session shape
types/next-auth.d.ts.description: Describes what information is available about a signed-in user, including their role and customer ID.

types/product.ts.name: Product data shape
types/product.ts.description: Describes the structure of a product record — images, options, and pricing — used throughout the site.
